items.name: СберСпасибо (SberSpasibo)
items.description: In March 2023, data allegedly taken from СберСпасибо (SberSpasibo), the loyalty program of Russian bank Сбербанк (Sberbank), was published online.

items.name: Harvard
items.description: In November 2025, Harvard University suffered a data breach later linked to a ShinyHunters "pay or leak" extortion attempt.

items.name: Assurance Retraite
items.description: In September 2024, the French national pension fund Assurance Retraite suffered a data breach affecting approximately 370k assistance beneficiaries.

items.name: Gîtes de France
items.description: In May 2026, the French holiday rental network Gîtes de France suffered a data breach affecting some of its departmental branches.

items.name: Crunchbase
items.description: In January 2026, the private company intelligence platform Crunchbase was targeted in a ShinyHunters "pay or leak" extortion attempt.

items.name: Sharecare
items.description: In August 2026, the digital health company Sharecare was the target of a ShinyHunters "pay or leak" extortion campaign.

items.name: Neogen
items.description: In August 2026, the food and animal safety organisation Neogen was the target of a ShinyHunters "pay or leak" extortion attempt. The group later published data it claimed had been obtained from Neogen.

items.name: CyrusOne
items.description: In August 2026, data centre operator CyrusOne was the target of a ShinyHunters "pay or leak" extortion attempt.

items.name: Double Counter
items.description: In October 2026, the Discord server protection service Double Counter suffered a data breach attributed to a vulnerability in the Metabase analytics tool.

items.name: Angel One
items.description: In July 2024, the Indian stock brokerage firm Angel One confirmed that data leaked online related to a breach that occurred in April 2023.
